title: Support SharePoint paths containing hash and percent characters
summary: SharePoint connector now supports file paths containing hash and percent characters by adding separate decoded-path APIs backed by ResourcePath endpoints, with a new REST Base Folder Path Format setting to control URL decoding behavior.
key_points: New decoded-path SharePoint Client APIs backed by ResourcePath endpoints handle names containing # and %
The connector uses them for file upload, download, delete, listing and existence checks, and for folder operations
New REST Base Folder Path Format setting defaults to URL (also for existing rows); Decoded Path keeps literal names like Reports%20Archive
Existing URL-based public client APIs are unchanged and Graph accounts are not affected
Attachment paths and filenames are never unescaped; only the base folder and the site prefix taken from the URL are decoded
quote: This PR adds separate decoded-path SharePoint Client APIs backed by ResourcePath endpoints and uses them in the legacy connector
